text:
deploy-bot: rolling out release v2.14.0 -> 10% traffic (canary). route: /api/generate. commit: 7f3a2d. start_ts=1901122334 :rocket:

taylor: seeing spike in 502s for /api/generate from canary nodes, +6% error rate over baseline in the last 5m. dashboard: https://console.redwood/rollouts/7f3a2d

maya: confirmed on logs — 502 coming from inference-proxy on eu-west-1-canary-2. sample log:
```
2026-03-20T14:12:01Z inference-proxy[eu-west-1-canary-2]: upstream read timeout -> 502
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z inference-proxy[eu-west-1-canary-2]: kvcache miss spike
```

sam: is this surfaceable to users? latency or correctness?

taylor: internal-only so far, but p95 latency up ~80ms and user-facing error rate ticked for a subset (region eu-west-1).

raj: suggest we pause the percent rollout and pin traffic back to stable while SRE triages. can we do a quick differential? run canary vs stable 100 requests through repro harness.

maya: +1 to pause. can someone hit the deploy command? i'm OOO next 20m.

deploy-bot: command options:
- `/deploy pause --release 7f3a2d` -> pause traffic shift
- `/deploy pin --version stable --route /api/generate` -> pin route to stable
- `/deploy rollback --release 7f3a2d --to 7f2b9a` -> rollback to prior release

sam: invoking pause now `/deploy pause --release 7f3a2d`
deploy-bot: pause accepted. current traffic for 7f3a2d set to 10% -> 0% (paused). action_ts=1901122389 :white_check_mark:

raj: allocating quick canary harness run now (100 reqs) — running from eu-west-1 and us-west-2 to compare. link: https://ci/rollout-tests/7f3a2d/compare

ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-213 - "Canary 7f3a2d: 502 spike on /api/generate" assigned to eng-oncall. slack: #inc-213

maya: i'll capture request traces and kvcache stats while SRE looks at the proxy. can we also pin the route to stable for eu-west-1 only?

sam: pinned route `/api/generate` -> stable for region eu-west-1. command: `/deploy pin --route /api/generate --region eu-west-1 --version stable`

deploy-bot: pin accepted. routing policy updated. pin_ts=1901122440

taylor: thanks. once SRE confirms root cause we can either patch and resume a smaller canary or roll forward after validation.

raj: noting action items: 1) SRE triage on proxy timeouts; 2) run KV cache heatup script against canary nodes; 3) reproduce with harness and attach traces to INC-2026-213.

maya: adding release notes note: "paused v2.14.0 rollout due to 502 spike in eu-west-1; pinned /api/generate to stable for eu-west-1; investigating proxy+kvcache behavior."

sam: documenting the change window and owners. tagging product for customer comms if needed. :spiral_note_pad:

deploy-bot: thread closed for actioning. update INC-2026-213 with findings and next decision (rollback / resume / rollforward). last_action_ts=1901122459
